screenshots.description: AccuMed EHR patient chart summary. Sidebar (Chart View, Patient Search, Demographics, Treatment Plan, Vitals), top app header with module icons, and patient banner 'Matulich,Kylie #100233 - Female, DOB 01/17/2003, Age 14'. Work area shows Appointments, Patient Assessments (PHQ-9), Documents, Medications, Vitals, Allergies.
AccuMed EHR full-window patient summary view with left navigation sidebar, top toolbar, patient banner, and multi-panel clinical work area.

AccuMed EHR Doctor Dashboard. Left sidebar (Dashboard, Schedule, Alerts, Patient Tracker, Messages, Case Load), top module header, and work area with Schedule, Alerts, Case Load (patient accounts/names/program), Messages, Tasks.
